description:
Healstack is a personal substance tracker, harm reduction wiki, and health dashboard.

Log doses with a journal you can filter and search, browse a 200+ substance wiki with harm reduction data, and see your health trends in one dashboard. Your data stays in your account — no ads, no data sales.

FEATURES
- Dose logging with journal, filters, and search
- 200+ substance wiki with harm reduction information
- Health dashboard with trends over time
- Private by design

Healstack is built for harm reduction: honest information and personal tracking to help you make safer choices.
